description: The bar chart illustrates the number of tokens distributed across various text categories. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Categories", with the individual text labels rotated diagonally. The categories, ordered from left to right, are Administrative, Religion, Non-fiction, Fiction, Law, News, an obscured label covered by a grey rectangle, and Blogs. The vertical axis represents the values, labeled "Tokens (K)", indicating units in thousands. It features a linear scale with a visible range from 0 to 10000, and numeric tick labels are spaced at regular intervals of 2000. The chart displays eight light blue vertical bars, each corresponding to a category on the horizontal axis. Every bar is annotated with its exact numerical value in dark blue text directly above it. The values shown are 6472 for Administrative, 652 for Religion, 1889 for Non-fiction, 387 for Fiction, 354 for Law, 10584 for News, 1626 for the obscured category, and 32 for Blogs. The tallest bar is News at 10584, and the shortest is Blogs at 32. The bars are not sorted in any specific alphabetical or numerical order. Visually, the chart emphasizes the exact data points through the numerical annotations, while a grey rectangular box obscures the text of the seventh category label on the horizontal axis.
